concept: A single scarlet five-petal bloom with a warm yellow centre and a sage stem/leaf pair, on an opaque white field. A botanical motif entirely distinct from the celestial first idea.
hypothesis: Broad held-contact petals can form a coherent organic silhouette; overlapping sage paths should frame the blossom without needing unverified fine-point control.
recreate: d02-clean-base-a02: all stages on a reconciled canvas
baseline_review: Assess petal readability, centre/flower proportion, leaf taper, stem weight, spacing and edge cleanliness. This baseline does not count toward the five accepted improvements.
